what: Stacked photos change every 4 seconds — the current photo’s mask height shrinks from 100% → 0 while stuck to the bottom (1.2s expo.out, delayed .2s), revealing the next photo from the top. If a back backdrop panel (back) is linked, the backdrop of the same index changes with it at .5 → 1 (.8s) and 1.08 → 1 (4s linear).

options.dur: Duration of the cover lifting (sec), default 1.2
options.from: Side where the cover attaches: bottom, top, left, right. Default bottom
options.back: Selector for the background panel to switch in the same order (each child is one slide) — if none, photos only
options.[data-fx-part=slide]: One photo to overlay (needs two or more to rotate)
options.first: Time until first turn (sec), default same as every
options.order: If random, picks a random section other than the current one (when there are three or more) — default is in order

from.where: shared.js maskSlider (brand story: seven small photos + a large background behind them) — original _mask_slider (duration 1.2 · interval 4000 · expo.out · delay .2 · direction bottom)

index.js Hero large photo · small photo, two slots (original main.js startMaskSlide — the next photo covers from the left via clip-path inset(0 100% 0 0) → 0 over 1200ms ease, rests 2500ms and repeats · random among work photos, the two slots never show the same photo)
from.options: from: right; every: 3.7; first: 2.5; dur: 1.2; delay: 0; ease: 0.25,0.1,0.25,1; order: random
from.note: In the original a new section unfolds from above, while in this part the current section’s cover is pulled away to the right. The visible boundary moves the same way. Keeping the two cells from showing the same photo is outside the part (the caller splits the photos)
